# Agent Template
# Copy this file to create a new agent definition.
# File naming: <agent-name>.agent.md (kebab-case)

# Instructions:
# 1. Copy this file to .github/agents/<your-agent-name>.agent.md
# 2. Fill in the front matter (description, name)
# 3. Define the agent's responsibilities and guidelines
# 4. Register the agent in .github/agents-config/registry.yaml
# 5. Update the orchestrator's agent table

---
```yaml
---
description: "<One-line description of what this agent does and when to use it>"
name: <Agent Display Name>
---
```
